selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512MB compressed in-memory (zram) swap configured, active
selected_evidence.summary: zram-generator installed; /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf created with zram-size=512, compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100; swapon --show confirms 512M zram0 device active with zstd algorithm in /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm

selected_evidence.requirement: Swap preferred over any disk-backed swap
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed zero disk swap present (swapon --show empty); after configuration only zram0 exists at priority 100, so zram is the exclusive and therefore preferred swap device both immediately and after reboot

Captured pre-restart boot_id (d052eb57...) and healthy zram swap state, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id (e62f565a...) proving an actual restart occurred, then verified systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service auto-ran at boot and swapon shows the same 512M zstd zram0 device active with no manual intervention

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP: install zram-generator =="
sudo -n dnf install -y zram-generator

echo "== STEP: configure zram-generator =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[zram0]
zram-size = 512
compression-algorithm = zstd
swap-priority = 100
EOF
cat /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf

echo "== STEP: reload systemd and start device unit =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl start systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service
sleep 2

echo "== STEP: verify swap active =="
swapon --show
free -h
cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm
cat /sys/block/zram0/disksize

echo "== STEP: verify unit enabled/active for boot =="
systemctl status systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service --no-pager || true
systemctl is-enabled systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service 2>&1 || true
echo "note: zram-generator units are generated dynamically at boot via systemd-zram-generator, activated by swap.target dependency"
systemctl cat systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service --no-pager | grep -i wantedby || true
